projectTitle: Chicago Charter Bus Rental fleet planner
description: Small libraries (Dart, Ruby, PHP, C#, Python, JavaScript, Rust) and an agent skill that recommend the fewest vehicles for a Chicago group charter headcount from published fleet seat sizes.
rules: Seat counts are the top of the published ranges: SuperCoach 57, Coach Bus 44, Small Coach Bus 28, Executive Sprinter Van 15, Party Bus 45, Trolley 30.
The planners are estimates, not quotes, bookings or availability statements.
recommend_fleet returns the fewest vehicles and then the fewest spare seats.
